title: Two more men charged with Primrose Hill murder
originalTitle: Two more men charged with Primrose Hill murder
content:
Two more men have been charged with murder following a fatal stabbing on Primrose Hill in north London.

Finbar Sullivan, 21, died after being attacked shortly after 18:30 BST on 7 April.

Alexis Bidace, 25, of Fore Street, Edmonton and Ernest Boateng, 25, of Keswick Drive, Enfield, are due to appear at Wimbledon Magistrates' Court.

Another man, Oliuwadamilola Ogunyankinnu, 27, was previously charged with murder and is due to appear before the Old Bailey later.

A fourth man, Khalid Abdulqadir, was charged with grievous bodily harm, violent disorder and possession of a knife and appeared in court on Tuesday.

The Metropolitan Police were called following reports of a fight at the popular beauty spot.

Sullivan was found with stab wounds and was treated by paramedics, but he died at the scene.

A second man, aged in his 20s, was discovered by officers on nearby Regent's Park Road with stab wounds that were not life-changing.

Sullivan, who was known as Fin to friends and family, was a film student at the London Screen Academy.

His father, Chris Sullivan, 65, previously told BBC London he had lost his only son who had recently overcome some health challenges, including being diagnosed with an autoimmune disease and going blind in one eye.

"All of his friends said he was the light, the leader. His friends' parents loved him.

"This is why it's so tragic," he said.

A police investigation is ongoing.
